device.category: monophonic analogue bass synthesizer with 16-step sequencer, arpeggiator, saturation and delay
device.based_on: Inspired by the Roland TB-303 (modelled separately as roland-tb-303), with a redesigned sequencer and keyboard; released 2022.

sources.title: Donner B1 Analog Bass Sequencer User Manual (Rev 2.0)
sources.note: Multilingual; English pages 1-18: panel, octave and tempo, pattern creation, playback, step edit, arpeggiator, MIDI, sync, power-on commands, app, SysEx table, specifications.

sources.title: Sound On Sound, 'Donner Essential B1' review
sources.note: One VCO, low-pass VCF, VCA with a simple decay envelope that runs filter and VCA; delay up to about half a second.

sources.title: MusicRadar, 'Donner B1 Analog Bass Sequencer review'
sources.note: Filter and resonance behave like a TB-303's; the delay is a tape delay emulation.

sources.title: David Hilowitz review (transcript on Donner's site)
sources.note: Four-octave note range; MIDI notes above velocity 96 play accented; class-compliant USB MIDI, not USB powered.

sources.title: Customer reviews on Donner's product pages
sources.note: Panel knobs send and receive no MIDI CCs.

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic; key priority low, high or last
architecture.patch_memory_note: 128 patterns store the sequence: per-step note, gate length, accent, slide and ratchet, plus tempo, length and transpose. Knob settings are not stored.
architecture.summary: An analogue TB-303-style voice: one VCO (saw or square) with a ±fifth pitch knob, a resonant low-pass VCF, one decay envelope to the filter (DEPTH) and VCA, and accent. After it, a saturation stage (drive, tone) and a delay (level, time, feedback), each switchable, then MASTER. An AUX input mixes with the output. A 26-key touch keyboard plays it directly, drives an eight-mode arpeggiator, or enters patterns into a 16-step sequencer with gate length, accent, slide and ratchet per step; the 16 white keys are also the step buttons.

modules.name: Keyboard and note control
modules.description: 26 touch keys (B1-C4) with octave shift; plays the voice, transposes the sequencer live (C3 centre, ±12) and feeds the arpeggiator. Mono with key priority and multi-trigger, slide or legato.

modules.name: Sequencer and arpeggiator
modules.description: 16-step sequencer, 128 patterns, with per-step note, gate length (0-8 eighths), accent, slide and ratchet (1-4); live accent, slide, ratchet, gate and mute while playing. Eight-mode arpeggiator. Clock internal, MIDI, USB, sync input, or automatic.

modules.name: VCO
modules.description: One analogue oscillator, sawtooth or square, with a centre-detented PITCH knob spanning a fifth either way.

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: Resonant analogue low-pass filter with TB-303-like character; the envelope sweeps it by DEPTH and accent brightens it.

modules.name: Envelope
modules.description: One decay envelope, retriggered by each note, driving the filter (by DEPTH) and the VCA; no release stage.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Shapes each note with the envelope; accented steps play louder.

modules.name: Saturation
modules.description: Switchable distortion with DRIVE (gain) and TONE (brightness).

modules.name: Delay
modules.description: Switchable delay with LEVEL, TIME (up to about 0.5 s) and FEEDBACK (one repeat at minimum).

modules.name: Output
modules.description: MASTER sets the level at MAIN OUT and PHONES; the AUX input is mixed in.

parameters.label: SLIDE (button)

parameters.label: GATE LENGTH (button)

ports.label: MAIN OUT

ports.label: AUX IN

ports.label: SYNC IN

connections.note: Sequencer or arpeggiator notes, transposed live from the keyboard.
Slide steps and multi-trigger off (slide) glide between pitches.
Sound On Sound: the envelope runs the filter and VCA.

indicators.label: LED display
indicators.function: Tempo, pattern, octave, gate length, ratchet and arpeggio mode.

indicators.label: step LEDs 1-16
indicators.function: Current step flashes; dark steps are rests.

indicators.label: button indicators
indicators.function: Lit or flashing on OCT, TEMPO TAP, ACCENT, HOLD, REC/EDIT, GATE LENGTH, SLIDE, RATCHET, SAVE, PATTERN, PLAY/STOP and ARP.

behaviours.name: Voice
behaviours.rule: One VCO (saw or square) into a resonant low-pass filter and VCA. One decay envelope opens the filter by DEPTH and shapes the VCA; there is no release. Accented notes are louder and brighter by ACCENT. The filter passes some mid-range even at its lowest cutoff, as on a TB-303 (MusicRadar).

behaviours.name: Pattern entry (step-write)
behaviours.rule: REC/EDIT, then each key enters a note and advances; CLEAR/REST enters a rest. Before each note set GATE LENGTH (0 rest to 8 tie), ACCENT, SLIDE (into the next step) or RATCHET (1-4 repeats). A new note takes the previous step's gate length. Hold REC/EDIT with a step key to edit one step, playing or not.

behaviours.name: Playback
behaviours.rule: PLAY/STOP loops the pattern. Keys transpose live (C3 centre, ±12, notes out of range muted). Holding HOLD repeats the step; holding ACCENT, SLIDE, RATCHET or GATE LENGTH applies that to every step; holding CLEAR/REST mutes. Holding a step key 2 s toggles its rest. None of the live changes are saved.

behaviours.name: Saving and loading
behaviours.rule: Edits are lost unless saved: SAVE, choose 1-128 with ▲/▼, SAVE again. The last pattern loads at power-on. A pattern chosen while playing starts after the current one ends, unless pattern waiting is off.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: ARP on: held keys play in one of eight orders at the set tempo and octave; HOLD latches, GATE LENGTH sets note length (1-8), ACCENT accents every step.

behaviours.name: Sync
behaviours.rule: SYNC OUT always sends clock. SYNC IN needs clock source TRG or AUTO. Rate 1PPS (one step per pulse), 2PPQ (Korg), 24PPQ or 48PPQ; polarity rise or fall.

behaviours.name: MIDI
behaviours.rule: Notes in play the voice; above the accent threshold (default 96) they are accented. Keyboard, sequencer and arpeggiator notes and clock are sent to DIN, USB or both. Local control can disconnect the keyboard or either input from the voice. Panel knobs send and receive no MIDI.

behaviours.name: Effects order
behaviours.rule: Saturation then delay, each switchable, then MASTER; AUX IN is mixed at the output.
behaviours.note: The manual does not state the order; it follows the panel layout.

receives.note: velocity above the accent threshold sets accent
when clock source is MIDI, USB or automatic

midi.channel_note: Separate in and out channels 1-16; set in the app, by SysEx, or with a step key at power-on.
midi.note: No control changes: the panel is not on MIDI. Start/stop handling is assumed from the clock source options; the manual lists no MIDI implementation chart.

specifications.keyboard: 26 touch keys, B1-C4, 4-octave range with octave shift

source_inconsistencies: MAIN OUT is a 1/4" TS mono connector in the panel description but '1/4" TRS, unbalanced' in the specifications.
The arpeggiator gate length runs 1-8, the sequencer step gate length 0-8 (0 being a rest).
The live gate length note says 'Live ratchet will not be saved', a copy of the line above it.
The spec sheet lists the power switch as a slide switch; the panel description just says power on/off.

modelling_gaps.detail: Step note, gate, accent, slide and ratchet are modelled as one parameter each, standing for 16 values per pattern.
MIDI forwarding, soft through and local control hold one value per port or source; modelled as single enums with notes.
Not a circuit copy: the sequencer, keyboard and effects are Donner's own; reviewers find the filter close to a TB-303's.
